caption: The drawing features two views of a decorative pitcher, with both views shown side by side on a beige background. The pitchers are illustrated in brown, black, and white ink with some blue accents. Each pitcher is adorned with a scalloped pattern near the rim and depicts a detailed hunting scene. On the left pitcher, hounds are shown chasing a stag amidst bushes and foliage, rendered in brown and white with blue highlights on the stag. The right pitcher includes a similar scene with hounds and a stag in the center, surrounded by bushes and foliage, and also features two standing human figures holding staffs or spears—one on each side of the scene. The drawing is signed “chas. Casey” in the lower left and includes a typed note in the lower right corner that reads: “Decoration on Hound handled pitcher made by Wm. E. Warner’s Pottery, West Troy, N.Y.”
title: Pitcher
